$comment: Prompts for the interactive-answer format benchmark (#11113, docs/research/2026-10-09-ui-format-benchmark.md): the OpenUI Lang subset against minified nested JSON.
Each prompt asks for an answer the catalog can draw: steps, commands, choices side by side, tabs, links. They are tasks, not training data; do not tune the catalog prompt against them one by one.

prompts.prompt: How do I install Coder on my laptop and start it in a project?
Show me the two ways to connect my codebase: on the web and on my computer.
Walk me through signing Coder in to my account and turning on sync.
Give me the install command for macOS, Linux, and Windows, one tab each.
Compare a free chat and a Pro plan with cloud environments side by side.
Link me to the pages for downloads, the API docs, the roadmap, and our promises, each with one line about it.
How do I undo my last git commit but keep the changes? Show the command and what it does.
Steps to make a Python virtual environment and install requests, with the commands.
How do I make an SSH key and add it to GitHub? Number the steps and include the commands.
Give me the commands to clean up unused Docker images, containers, and volumes, with a warning about what each removes.
Help me pick between three code editors for a beginner: one card each with who it suits and a link.
Make a short checklist for a new contributor's first day: set up the repository, run the tests, and open a first pull request.
